We just opened the public demo of Terraphim Forge.

Self-hosted Gitea on Firecracker microVMs. Free. Anonymous registration. Full reset every 24 h.

https://t.co/CaMAjCew9j https://t.co/PvI72SiV90

Long write-up + how it's built:
https://t.co/70Mj3N7YzF

If you break the demo, we'll fix it on the next 04:00 UTC tick.

gtr is our PageRank-based Gitea issue triage. Scores issues by how many others they unblock — fix the highest-leverage ones first.

git clone https://t.co/tTM4xakokV
cd gitea-robot && bun install
export GITEA_TOKEN=<pat>
./bin/gtr triage -o YOU -r REPO
./bin/gtr ready -o YOU -r REPO
./bin/gtr graph -o YOU -r REPO

Read-only browse of terraphim/gitea-robot works without a login.
